name: Ammunition
says: A ranged attack needs ammunition and spends one piece per attack, drawing it is part of the attack (free hand for a one-handed weapon), half is recovered after the battle, and used in melee the weapon is improvised (a sling must be loaded to hurt).
does: Each weapon is tied to its ammunition kind (effects/ammunition.json); when the owner or master has set a count for the kind, each ranged shot spends one, a kind at 0 refuses the shot, the undo refunds it, and a minute of searching after the combat gives back half rounded down once per combat; a kind with no count spends nothing (RN-02); the melee use is a separate improvised line (1d4+STR bludgeoning, not proficient, spends nothing); the free hand and the loaded sling are not checked.
seen: Count tag on the attack row (3 or fewer warns, 0 turns the button off with 'o tiro não sai'), 'Improvisado: não gasta flecha' under the melee line, a rule line under the attacks, 'Recuperar a metade' on the sheet; nothing on the free hand or the sling.
fix: Say on the improvised line that a sling needs a bullet and that a one-handed weapon needs a free hand to load; show the rule line even when no kind is counted.

name: Finesse
says: A finesse weapon attacks and hurts with the owner's choice of Strength or Dexterity, the same one for both rolls.
does: The line takes the higher of STR and DEX for the attack and the same ability for the damage (a monk weapon under Martial Arts does the same).
seen: Only the totals on the attack row; the ability is not named.

name: Heavy
says: Small creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls with heavy weapons.
does: Nothing is applied to the roll: a Small character (halfling, gnome) that has a heavy weapon equipped gets a sheet reminder; the combat roll's mode never reads it, so the table adds the disadvantage by hand.
seen: 'Desvantagem nas jogadas de ataque com <arma>: arma pesada para criaturas Pequenas.' under Lembretes in the sheet's features panel (only for Small characters); nothing in the attack row or the roll's sources.
fix: Feed the hint to the roll mode (a source 'arma pesada' for a Small attacker) or repeat it in the attack row.

name: Light
says: A light weapon is made for fighting with two weapons: after the Attack action with a light melee weapon in one hand, a bonus action attacks with a different light melee weapon in the other, without the ability modifier on the damage (unless negative).
does: A melee weapon with the light property makes the line a Light line; after the Attack action with a light melee line, a second light melee line is a bonus action attack whose damage drops the positive ability modifier (kept with the Two-Weapon Fighting style, a negative modifier and the magic bonus); hands are not tracked, so the check is 'two light melee lines carried' and the off-hand may be the same line as the main hand; a Dueling bonus stays on the off-hand line.
seen: 'Ataque com a outra mão, sem o modificador no dano' under the bonus action row, with the economy mark 'bonus'; Dueling carries 'Inclui +2 de Duelismo (sem outra arma na mão)'.
fix: Refuse the off-hand attack when it names the same line as the main-hand attack.

name: Loading
says: With a loading weapon only one piece of ammunition is fired per action, bonus action or reaction, however many attacks the character has.
does: Nothing limits it: Extra Attack lets a crossbow fire twice in the Attack action and each shot spends a piece; only a text tells the table.
seen: 'Uma besta com Recarga dispara uma vez por ação' in the rule line under the attacks, shown only while some ammunition kind is counted.
fix: Refuse a second shot of a loading weapon in the same action (attackEconomy), or show the line without the ammunition count.

name: Monk
says: A monk gets Martial Arts benefits while unarmed or wielding only monk weapons, with no armor and no shield.
does: A monk weapon line takes the better of STR and DEX, the martial arts die if bigger, and counts for the Martial Arts bonus strike while no armor and no shield is worn; 'wielding only monk weapons' is not checked (a non-monk weapon in the other hand changes nothing).
seen: Nothing says the condition; the monk die simply shows in the damage.
fix: Add a sheet reminder that the benefits need only monk weapons in hand.

name: Reach
says: The weapon adds 5 feet to the reach, also for opportunity attacks with it.
does: The line's range is 10 ft (not a throw range, no long range); a player's target list and the reach check use 10 ft, and an opportunity attack uses the longest melee reach.
seen: Row detail 'alcance 3 m' (instead of 'corpo a corpo'); the map targets reach 2 squares.

name: Special: Lance
says: No SRD text in the repository (the property says 'explained in the weapon's description'); the lance's own rule, disadvantage against a target within 5 feet and two hands unless mounted, is not in the data.
does: The lance is a melee line with 10 ft reach and no special rule: no disadvantage against an adjacent target, not two-handed (a shield keeps counting).
seen: Nothing.
fix: Add the lance's text to the equipment description and show it on the attack row, or add a roll source 'lança a menos de 1,5 m'.

name: Special: Net
says: No SRD text in the repository; the net's own rule (restrains a Large or smaller target, one attack per action, thrown 5/15 ft) is not in the data.
does: The net is a ranged thrown line (DEX, 5/15 ft) with no damage dice and no damage type: a hit opens a pending damage with no dice; nothing applies or says the restrained condition or the single attack.
seen: A row 'Rede' with a bonus and no damage text; nothing on the restraint.
fix: Show the net's text on the row and offer the restrained condition on a hit.

name: Thrown
says: A thrown weapon may be thrown for a ranged attack, using the same ability for attack and damage as in melee.
does: A melee thrown weapon keeps its melee ability (finesse takes the best) and a throw range; at 5 ft or less it is a melee attack, beyond it a ranged one with the long-range and hostile-nearby rules, no ammunition spent; a dart and a net are ranged lines with the throw range; the versatile die is wrong when thrown (see the versatile row).

name: Two-Handed
says: The weapon requires two hands to attack with.
does: The line is marked two-handed: an equipped two-handed weapon takes the shield's +2 away from the armor class (RN-33) and counts as held in both hands for the fighting styles; the app has no hands, so a second weapon beside it is not refused.
seen: 'duas mãos' tag and a warning on the gear row, 'Não conta na CA' on the shield, the sheet hint 'O escudo não conta na CA enquanto uma arma de duas mãos está equipada'.

name: Versatile
says: A versatile weapon is used with one or two hands; the damage in parentheses is for two hands on a melee attack.
does: The grip is worked out from the gear (shield, another weapon or Dueling means one hand, else two) and the combat rolls the die of that grip, but it also rolls the two-handed die for a spear or trident thrown at range, which is not a melee attack; the master can apply a different amount on a player's damage (RN-02), the player cannot change the grip.
seen: 'Com duas mãos; com uma: 1d6+3' under the damage and the 'Arremesso' line; the thrown roll still uses the two-handed die.
code: backend/internal/characters/combatturn.go combatAttack (Grip two hands picks VersatileDice); backend/internal/rules/attacks.go versatileGrip; backend/internal/play/combat_attack.go openHitDamage
fix: Carry both dice on the combat attack and roll the one-handed die when the throw is a ranged attack (attackShape.rangedAt).

name: Weapon range (normal and long)

says: No SRD text in the repository for silvering a weapon; the monsters' 'nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered' resistance is bypassed by a silvered weapon.
does: The owner (before the lock) or the master marks a weapon silvered, or a weapon rule marks it; the mark rides on the attack line and the damage step skips a resistance or immunity 'nonmagical unless silvered' for it (RN-02); the master's log names the reason.
seen: 'Prateada' chip on the attack row and the gear row; the master's damage steps say 'Resistência ... de ataque não mágico nem prateado'.

name: Drawing and stowing a weapon (free object interaction)
says: No SRD text in the repository; one object interaction a turn is free, so drawing or stowing a weapon costs nothing the first time.
does: In a running combat, on the owner's turn the first weapon drawn or stowed is free (object interaction), the second weapon and the shield cost the action (or Haste's extra action), armor is refused, the master is never charged and the undo gives the interaction back (RN-01); drawing ammunition is part of the attack.
seen: 'Sacar ou guardar' fold with the cost on each button ('Sacar · grátis', 'Guardar · ação') and the rule line '1ª arma do turno: grátis; depois, a ação. Escudo: ação. Armadura: só fora do combate.'

name: Attacking without proficiency
says: No SRD text in the repository; an attack with a weapon the character is not proficient with does not add the proficiency bonus.
does: A weapon line adds the proficiency bonus only when a proficiency matches the weapon's key or its category (simple, martial); otherwise the bonus is the ability modifier alone, and the improvised melee line is never proficient; the damage is unchanged.
seen: Only the attack total on the row (without +prof); no tag says 'sem proficiência'.

name: Unarmed strike
says: No SRD text for the base unarmed strike in the repository; the monk's Martial Arts uses DEX or STR and a martial arts die in place of 1.
does: Every sheet has the line 'Golpe Desarmado': proficient, STR, 1+STR bludgeoning (never below 0), reach 5 ft; a monk with no armor and no shield takes the better of DEX and STR and rolls the martial arts die; Ki-Empowered Strikes makes it magical for resistances only.
seen: Last line of the attack list with the damage as a number (e.g. '4'), the Martial Arts bonus strike under the bonus action.
